purpose: Design a safe bridge from proven public readmodel outputs into the active static panel data directory without changing core runtime logic.

problem.gap: The active panel does not directly consume the proven public/backpressure readmodel files.

bridge_contract.name: panel_public_readmodel_bridge_v1
input_validation: manifest cache_sha256 equals source cache sha256
index cache_sha256 equals source cache sha256
index manifest_sha256 equals source manifest sha256
output_validation: target files parse as JSON after write
target sha256 equals source sha256 for copied cache/manifest/index
status file records bridge timestamp, hashes, and safety flags

implementation_order.name: bridge_script_apply_noapi
implementation_order.action: Add tools/panel_public_readmodel_bridge_v1.py and run once locally.
implementation_order.expected_result: active_panel_8096/current/data/backpressure_* files exist and match public source hashes.

implementation_order.name: panel_reference_probe_no_html_change
implementation_order.action: Request /data/backpressure_readmodel_refresh_cache.json over localhost 8096 and verify HTTP 200 plus hash match.
implementation_order.expected_result: public readmodel is reachable through active panel static server.

implementation_order.name: panel_ui_bind_plan
implementation_order.action: Only after N14B passes, decide whether index.html should display bridge status or backpressure tiles.
implementation_order.expected_result: No blind UI edit before data bridge is proven.

implementation_order.name: timer_or_manual_refresh_policy
implementation_order.action: Decide whether bridge is manual, timer-based, or triggered after backpressure refresh.
implementation_order.expected_result: No extra timer until bridge correctness is proven.

risk_controls: Do not change panel service yet.
Do not edit index.html until HTTP static data serving is proven.
If source validation fails, write no panel target and mark SAFE_DOWNGRADE.
If target write fails, leave previous panel data intact.

success_criteria.n14a: bridge script writes target files and status with hash equality
success_criteria.n14c: panel UI explicitly references bridge data or status after approval
success_criteria.overall: public readmodel to active panel static serving is proven without API, wallet, trade, DB write, or core change
